improvements_over_v1: The five edge paths no longer form dominant U-shaped return loops.
All fifteen edge-heirs are shorter than their secondary parent; V1 had twelve of fifteen longer than the parent.
No direct flower-reserve intrusion is reported; V1 reported twelve such issues.
Top and bottom edge contacts share a consistent envelope and do not protrude beyond it.
The three seeds produce visibly different branch placement, direction, length and tertiary allocation.
remaining_visual_failures: Many secondary roots stay too close to the primary after attachment, creating doubled or fused strokes.
Several carrier secondaries read as continuations of the primary instead of lateral descendants.
Most tertiary branches read as small hooks or ticks rather than useful third-level growth.
Descendants cluster around a few roots while large regions around the flower reserves remain empty.
The full strip lacks a coherent alternating fan rhythm across neighbouring BranchUnits.
Seed 4102 contains out-of-bounds lower growth and seed 4103 remains locally tangled near the lower trough.
The 2x repeat preserves the same local failures and reveals crowded seam-adjacent growth rather than a balanced repeat.
decision: Recursive topology remains worth testing, but V2 does not pass. A next iteration must solve root departure and sibling fan allocation before adding more branches or depth.
